headline: Eight BSE 500 stocks deliver over 100% returns since Diwali 2025 despite broader market consolidation
hook: Eight BSE 500 stocks double despite weakness
summary: While the Nifty 50 declined nearly 3% since Diwali 2025, eight BSE 500 stocks more than doubled investors' wealth, led by Aditya Infotech with 191% gains and HFCL with 186%. ACE Equities data shows only 190 stocks from the index posted positive returns during this period of broader market weakness. Major brokerages including ICICI Direct and Motilal Oswal remain constructive on Samvat 2083, projecting double-digit earnings growth and favoring sectors like BFSI, manufacturing, and consumption. For retail investors, the data underscores that selective stock picking has outperformed the broader index significantly over the past year.
whats_next: Samvat 2083 equity performance and corporate earnings delivery
why_it_matters: Stock selection matters more than broad index growth in weak markets.
winners_losers: Niche large gainers gain / broader index laggards hurt

headline: Aether Industries Q2 profit climbs 26.6% to ₹68 crore
hook: Aether Industries reports double-digit profit growth
summary: Aether Industries posted a net profit of ₹67.99 crore for the second quarter, marking a 26.62% increase compared to the same period last year. Revenue from operations grew by 23.95% to ₹347.21 crore, up from ₹280.1 crore in the previous year. The results reflect the company's performance during the July-September quarter.
why_it_matters: Stronger quarterly earnings may support current stock price valuation

headline: Aether Industries Q2 profit jumps 26 percent
hook: Specialty chemicals growth drives Aether's bottom line
summary: Aether Industries reported a 26 percent increase in net profit for the second quarter. Revenue growth was primarily supported by strong performance in its Contract Manufacturing (CRAMS) and Contract Engineering (CEM) business segments. The company continues to focus on high-margin specialty chemical production. This result reflects the firm's ability to scale its specialized manufacturing services despite broader chemical industry volatility.
why_it_matters: Stronger margins may signal improved earnings visibility for shareholders.

headline: Ace investor Sunil Singhania adds six stocks and likely exits two in Q2
hook: Six new bets from a market veteran
summary: Sunil Singhania’s Abakkus funds added six new stocks to its portfolio during the July-September quarter, including Aether Industries, BEML, and Paramount Communications. Amid foreign investor outflows and market volatility, the firm also likely exited Cyient DLM and TTK Healthcare following a 150% rally in the latter. Additionally, Abakkus has filed papers for an initial public offering of its own. Indian retail investors tracking marquee investor portfolios can use these filings to identify potential stock ideas and sector bets.
why_it_matters: Track marquee investor portfolio shifts for new stock ideas
winners_losers: Aether and BEML gain / Cyient DLM and TTK Healthcare hurt

headline: Sunil Singhania's Abakkus Fund raises stake in Aether Industries
hook: Ace investor increases Aether Industries holding
summary: Abakkus Flexi Cap Fund, led by Sunil Singhania, has acquired an additional 1.15% stake in Aether Industries. The specialty chemicals stock has gained 137% over the past year. Analysts note the stock maintains an uptrend despite recent profit-booking activity.
why_it_matters: Institutional buying often signals confidence in a company's growth prospects.
winners_losers: Aether shareholders gain / new buyers face premium

headline: Sunil Singhania's Abakkus Flexi Cap Fund buys Aether Industries and exits Cyient DLM in Q2
hook: Veteran investor shifts positions after big rally
summary: Veteran investor Sunil Singhania's Abakkus Flexi Cap Fund acquired a 1.15% stake in Aether Industries and increased its holding in Heritage Foods during Q2 FY27. At the same time, the fund appears to have exited Cyient DLM as its stake fell below 1% following a significant multi-month price rally. Retail investors often track portfolio adjustments by prominent fund managers to gauge sectoral trends and sentiment. This matters because institutional buying and selling can influence stock liquidity and price momentum in mid-cap counters.
why_it_matters: Tracks smart money movements in mid-cap stocks.
winners_losers: Aether Industries gains / Cyient DLM pressured
